title: Toolchain identity lives in one manifest that workflows and probes must match
statement: Every workflow pin of a runtime version, action digest, or verifier commit MUST equal the toolchain manifest by name and value, a host toolchain mismatch MUST be reported as a BLOCKED probe naming observed and required values, and the task-key toolchain digest MUST derive from the manifest so that editing it invalidates every cached result.
rationale: ADR-CHK-0002 gives the release workflow and the check runner one source of toolchain truth, closing the drift Article 36 scores.

strategy.rationale: A deterministic test corpus under tests/ and packages/*/tests observes this obligation; trace links the tests.
